abstract.quote: The critical success index of individual models across the three regions ranges from 0.45 to 0.7 and the percentage of flood captured ranges from 52% to 97%.

results.quote: The average CSI of the GFMs range from 0.45 (GLOFRIS) to 0.70 (JRC) for a 25 year flow.

literature_context.quote: CSI scores from other flood validation literature, in different validation regions, range from 0.3 to 0.9

conclusions.quote: with average CSI scores ranging from 0.45 to 0.7.

median.note: no median CSI is stated anywhere in the text

modis.quote: The DFO uses Moderate Resolution Image Spectroradiometer (MODIS) imagery to capture flood events globally, and stores them online in an open-access archive.

modis_fig3.quote: Overlap of individual global flood model extent for return period flows of 25 and 100 years and MODIS observed flood extent for Lokoja, Idah, and Chemba

abstract_glofas_means.quote: global mean CSI of 0.42 for basins with large upstream area ( > 1000 km2) and a CSI of 0.29 for basins with small upstream area (< 50 km2)

results_glofas_means.quote: the average CSI rose from 0.29 in the basins with a small upstream area (< 50 km2) to 0.42 in the basins with a large upstream area (≥1000 km2)

glofas_forcing.quote: The primary global dataset was GloFAS (Grimaldi et al., 2022), which provided long-term global coverage discharge data suitable for simulating floods at a global scale.

observed_discharge_results.quote: achieving an average CSI of 0.67 compared to the average global mean of 0.39 (Table 2)

observed_discharge_discussion.quote: when SFINCS was forced with observed USGS discharges, the average CSI was 0.67 (HR = 0.86; FAR = 0.21)

global_mean.quote: with a mean CSI of 0.39 using GloFAS modelled discharges as input forcing

sadana2026.reading: 0.42 / 0.29 are average CSI by basin upstream-area class (Table 3; GloFAS discharge forcing; 499 events); 0.67 is the average CSI of ten US events forced with observed USGS discharge (Table 2 / Sect. 3.7); the global mean with GloFAS forcing is 0.39 (not drawn).
